summary.headline: Star-Based Birth Delineations
summary.text: Astrological delineations for births under stars in Leo, Hydra, and the Hyades, describing wealth, fame, beauty, priesthood, secrecy, and sexual reputation. The Hyades star is said to have double power, especially in relation to Antares in Scorpio, producing glorious and influential people across the inhabited world.
